review_rubric.source_support_preserved: Every factual claim retains its own supporting source. Paraphrases are allowed; judge the whole output, including summary.
review_rubric.no_added_attribution: The direct Aero statement gains no invented speaker, uncertainty or verification disclaimer.
review_rubric.original_attribution_preserved: Beta remains an author estimate; Gamma remains a company statement. Exact introductory phrases are not required.
review_rubric.plan_not_promoted_to_completed: Gamma is not reported as opened solely because 1 October precedes analysis_period.until.
review_rubric.quoted_question_does_not_trigger_date_di: The source participant question is not treated as a user request for chronology; avoid an unsolicited missing-date discussion.
review_rubric.publication_date_not_event_date: No publication timestamp becomes an event timestamp.
review_rubric.unknown_event_date_disclosed_for_explici: Answer the user time question by explaining the source does not establish the launch date.
review_rubric.no_invented_year: Keep 4 July without assigning a publication-derived year.
review_rubric.important_releases_precede_empty_confere: Orion and Aero product changes precede conferences with no product news, using supporting fact IDs for identity.
review_rubric.tail_event_not_lost: Include Orion although its source is last and short output requires selection.
review_rubric.no_filler: Do not invent events to fill the item limit.
